claim: Three role-open analytics reads still serve a sales figure that predates ADR 0298 to any member of the house: pos-revenue, basket and insights in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts. The claim holds once each carries @Roles( with RolesGuard (on the route or the class) among its own decorators, or policyFor(/withSales/salesGateFor( in its body (ADR 0145 ROLE_POLICY, ADR 0290 §5). The verify also checks table-performance, waiters and hot-tables, which ADR 0348 gave RolesGuard + @Roles("owner", "manager") (claim A-TABLE-AND-SERVER-TAKINGS-NEED-A-MANAGER), so removing either guard there reopens it. Not checked, because a grep cannot tell them from the gated code beside them: the stored insights overview composes, the generated insights in consult's evidence pack, and the check-based goal metrics (wine_revenue, avg_check, checks). Carried from PR #617's row when #617 was split (ADR 0298, 2026-10-31), verify unchanged; #617's prose still said six routes. Measured 2026-10-31 on this branch: prints OPEN: pos-revenue, basket, insights; with salesGateFor( added to all three bodies it HOLDS, with two it prints OPEN: insights. 2026-11-13, fix/till-figures-withheld-from-staff: pos-revenue and basket now carry salesGateFor( (staff get salesWithheld: true and every figure null, pinned on a staff token by till-figures-withheld-from-staff.spec.ts); measured on that branch it prints OPEN: insights, against OPEN: pos-revenue, basket, insights on its base. [2026-11-13, r30: the insight feed keeps only the sentences of the classes the caller's ROLE_POLICY row sees (insightsForRole in role-reads.ts), so a staff login never reads waiter.avg_check.peer_rank, the till, a spend or a margin there; resolved. recommendations' staff_spread is outside this claim and still open (ADR 0348 item 3).]
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; P='apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts'; L=pathlib.Path(P).read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\n'); S=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if re.match(r'^\s*@(Get|Post|Patch|Put|Delete)\(',l)]; K=min([i for i,l in enumerate(L) if re.match(r'^export class ',l)]+[len(L)]); CG=any(re.search(r'@UseGuards\([^)]*\bRolesGuard\b',l) for l in L[:K]); R=['pos-revenue','waiters','basket','table-performance','hot-tables','insights']; I={r:[i for i in S if re.match(r'^\s*@Get\(.'+re.escape(r)+'/:restaurantId',L[i])] for r in R}; st=lambda i: max([j for j in range(i) if not (L[j].strip().startswith(('@','//','*','/*')) or L[j].strip()=='')]+[-1])+1; nx=lambda i: min([st(j) for j in S if j>i]+[len(L)]); sg=lambda i: min([j for j in range(i+1,nx(i)) if re.match(r'^\s{2}(async\s+)?[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\(',L[j])]+[nx(i)]); cl=lambda a,b: '\n'.join(l for l in L[a:b] if not l.strip().startswith(('//','*','/*'))); dec=lambda i: cl(st(i),sg(i)); body=lambda i: cl(sg(i),nx(i)); ok=lambda i: (('@Roles(' in dec(i)) and (CG or re.search(r'@UseGuards\([^)]*\bRolesGuard\b',dec(i)) is not None)) or re.search(r'policyFor\(|withSales|salesGateFor\(|insightsForRole\(',body(i)) is not None; bad=[r for r in R if len(I[r])!=1 or not ok(I[r][0])]; print('OPEN: '+', '.join(bad) if bad else 'HOLDS'); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

claim: The four money lenses of apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts (GET menu-engineering, cashflow, vendor-scorecard and wine) withhold their figures from a role that does not see their classes (ADR 0348 decision 3): each handler body calls lensHidden( before its service, and the overview handler hands the caller's classes to getOverview through seesFor(.
